limitations: Three short prompts, context512, greedy; no long-context or external memory-pressure stress.
Nonzero whole-system disk reads; counters do not isolate model file or drive H. Not a pure RAM bandwidth benchmark.
No MTP; no batching, frequency admission or new arithmetic. Size32 is not performance-tested.
Control must be from this same-binary ABBA, not the older MTP probe or MIMO-05 benchmark.

explanations.numerical: Slab OFF: F32 mmap_pipe_2_256 exact logits failed, same signature as prior pipeline diagnostic. Bytes passed. Repeat passed without numerical changes; root cause NOT resolved and thresholds NOT relaxed.
explanations.occupancy: Eight small 8MiB-cache assertions assumed individual allocation reuse/eviction. Packed blocks can hit or recycle instead. Numerical comparisons all passed. Only occupancy assertions changed; dedicated slab tests verify pins, budgets, release and reuse.
explanations.native: Uncached native reference aborted at numbers prompt with 95% global RAM guard. No managed mmap working-set cap in this diagnostic path. Completed managed-cache0 run became the explicit reference. Native failure excluded from speed.
explanations.first_abba: V1 used a full scan of blocks. V2 indexes non-full blocks by size, preserving slot choice. Separate series; changes in absolute speed cannot be attributed to the index alone.
